{{Top|leg}}
The '''Shadow Egg''' was created by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]]. He named it the shadow egg the instant of its creation. It hovered where the [[Shadow Throne]] once stood and was held up by the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] that once supported the shadow throne. It was absolutely dark on the inside and Shadowspawn considered it his cocoon. It collapsed after Luke Skywalker befriended the [[Melter]]s.
